div.head: VI Atr 6
div.ab: ⁊ la gyt we willað biddan freonda gehwylcne ⁊ eal folc eac læran georne, þæt hy inwerdre heortan ænne God lufian ⁊ ælcne hæþendom georne ascunian.
And la, gyt we willað biddan freonda gehwylcne and eal folc eac læran georne þæt hy inwerdre heortan ænne God lufian and ælcne hæþendom georne ascunian.
And now behold, we will beseech all our friends and likewise earnestly enjoin upon the whole nation, to love one God from their inmost heart, and zealously shun all heathen practices.
And indeed, we entreat all our friends and likewise zealously instruct all the people that they love the one God with their innermost hearts and vehemently renounce all heathen practices.
Und wohl wollen wir der Freunde jeglichen ferner bitten und auch alles Volk eifrig anweisen, dass sie von innerstem Herzen Einen Gott lieben und jedes Heidenthum eifrig vermeiden.
And indeed we will further ask each of our friends, and also eagerly instruct all the people, to love one God from their inmost hearts and eagerly shun all heathenism.
